targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM email_campaigns WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN opened THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 as value FROM email_campaigns WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 as value FROM email_campaigns WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN replied THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 as value FROM email_campaigns WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as sent, SUM(CASE WHEN opened THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as opened, SUM(CASE WHEN clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as clicked FROM email_campaigns WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) as time, (SUM(CASE WHEN bounced THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 as value FROM email_campaigns WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
